summary: StyleVault is a DeepSeek Harness theme plugin that offers multiple built-in style presets with in-app appearance controls for colors, fonts, sizing, and corner radius, plus saving, importing, exporting, and sharing of style schemes.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily an interface customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness web users, focused on theme and layout styling. Evidence shows it supplies built-in color presets, a settings panel for real-time appearance adjustments, and save/import/export/share of local theme schemes, with additional runtime controls via a global console API, and no broader automation, data, or external workflow behavior.
